statements.t: As we approach the December 22nd PDUFA target date for lorundrostat, our focus is on completing our launch preparations so that we are ready to reach patients quickly, pending approval,” said Jon Congleton, Chief Executive Officer of Mineralys.
We continue to receive positive feedback from providers, payers and people living with hypertension, and we look forward to the potential to bring lorundrostat to millions of patients in need.”
